LanguageData.Raven_Building_StylingStation.label: (Raven) Styling Station
LanguageData.Raven_Building_StylingStation.descriptio: A dedicated styling station for the Raven race, equipped with a mirror and Raven Darkfeather Steel grooming tools. Ravens can use this to arrange their hairstyle, hair color, face, head, body, and skin color according to Character Editor appearance settings.
